visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a potential navigation issue.
visualRisks.details: The water symbol (#007fff) is not clearly distinguishable from the ground color (#d2b48c).
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase contrast between water and ground to improve visibility.

navigationRisks.details: The route markers are not clearly visible, especially in the areas with complex terrain or other objects like docks and houses.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Ensure that all route markers stand out against their background.
